17. An icosahedron is a regular polyhedron with 12 vertices, 20 faces, and 30 edges. How many rigid
rotations G are there for an icosahedron in R3?
s:
17. An icosahedron is a regular polyhedron with 12 vertices, 20 faces, and 30 edges. How many rigid
rotations G are there for an icosahedron in R3?
Answer: 60
There are 12 vertices, each with 5 neighbors. Any vertex and any of its neighbors can be rotated to
any other vertex-neighbor pair in exactly one way. There are 5 · 12 = 60 vertex-neighbor pairs.
